verdict.rationale: Through its Lowenstein x Clerky offering, the firm provides an online workflow. In it, founders incorporate a Delaware C corp and complete bylaws, director/officer appointments, founder stock issuances and 83(b) generation. Founder-specific vesting and IP details are captured as inputs, so this is interactive assembly rather than static templates. However, the automation engine is a partner's platform (Clerky), and the evidence covers formation and post-incorporation workflows only. missing for 10: evidence of first-party (non-partner) document automation, coverage beyond formation and 83(b) workflows, details of the interactive assembly UX, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, the firm ships self-serve document automation — interactive assembly of real legal documents I can complete online, not just static templates

citations.quote: clients can incorporate and fully set up a Delaware C corporation and seamlessly unlock additional startup legal workflows.

founders can complete essential incorporation tasks—including adoption of bylaws, appointment of directors and officers, founder stock issuances, and generation of 83(b) election forms—using standardized, venture grade documentation.
Post-Incorporation Setup also captures founder specific vesting and IP details and is $299 on pay per use or included with the Company Lifetime Package
